name: DomaIndex
tagline: domaindex is a batch domain availability checker for founders, indie makers, and developers
description: domaindex is a batch domain availability checker for founders, indie makers, and developers. Enter one keyword and domaindex fires up to 30 parallel RDAP requests across 100+ TLDs — results stream in as each registry responds, so slow TLDs never block fast ones. Click an available result to jump to registrar links; click a taken one to inspect the raw RDAP response. Built directly on RFC 7480 RDAP — not scraped WHOIS, no third-party aggregators, no stale caches.
